title:
一、英譯中：請將下列英文句子譯成中文。（15 分）
Trends come and go, and desserts are no exception. Today the egg tart is in, and perhaps tomorrow, donuts will be all the rage. However, some desserts can always withstand the test of time, and remain as popular as ever. This is definitely the case with macaroons.
answer: 流行來來去去，甜點也不例外。今天蛋塔正夯，也許明天就換甜甜圈當紅。然而，有些甜點總能禁得起時間的考驗，人氣始終不墜。馬卡龍正是如此。
hint:
句構拆解
  • Trends come and go：come and go＝來來去去、起起落落（固定說法）。
  • desserts are no exception：no exception＝也不例外。
  • the egg tart is in：be in＝正流行（口語）。
  • donuts will be all the rage：be all the rage＝蔚為風潮、當紅。
  • withstand the test of time：禁得起時間考驗。
  • remain as popular as ever：人氣始終不墜。
  • This is definitely the case with macaroons.：the case with＝……的情況正是如此。
關鍵詞
  • come and go 來來去去
  • be in 正流行；be all the rage 蔚為風潮
  • withstand 禁得起、抵擋
  • the test of time 時間的考驗
  • macaroon 馬卡龍（法式甜點）
翻譯技巧
  • be in、be all the rage 都是口語，中文用「正夯」「當紅」比「很流行」生動。
  • 「This is definitely the case with...」譯「……正是如此」，簡潔有力。
  • 四句短句，中文可保留同樣節奏，不要合併成一句長句。
易錯點
  • macaroon 在英文嚴格說是「椰子球」，但此處指法式 macaron（馬卡龍），譯「馬卡龍」才符合語境。
  • exception 不要譯成「例外情況」而漏掉「也」的語氣。

title:
二、中譯英：請將下列中文句子譯成英文。（15 分）
每天撥空關掉手機、電腦、電視及其他會讓人分心的事物。和周圍的人以有意義、從容的方式互動。仔細聆聽他們，對他們全神貫注。
answer: Set aside time every day to turn off your phone, computer, TV, and other distractions. Interact with the people around you in a meaningful and unhurried way. Listen to them carefully and give them your full attention.
hint:
句構策略
  • 原文三句都是祈使句（命令、建議），英文也用祈使句。
  • 「撥空」→ set aside time（或 make time）。
  • 「關掉手機、電腦、電視及其他會讓人分心的事物」→ turn off your phone, computer, TV, and other distractions（distractions 直接涵蓋「分心的事物」）。
  • 「以有意義、從容的方式互動」→ Interact with... in a meaningful and unhurried way。
  • 「仔細聆聽他們，對他們全神貫注」→ Listen to them carefully and give them your full attention。
關鍵詞
  • 撥空 set aside time／make time
  • 關掉 turn off
  • 分心的事物 distractions
  • 互動 interact with
  • 從容的 unhurried／leisurely
  • 全神貫注 give one's full attention
加分寫法
  • 「撥空」也可用 carve out time，更口語。
  • 「仔細聆聽」可強化為 listen attentively。
易錯點
  • 「其他會讓人分心的事物」不要逐字譯 things that make people distracted，用 other distractions 即可。
  • 「對他們全神貫注」不是 concentrate on them（太像讀書），用 give them your full attention 更自然。

title:
三、英文作文：（20 分）
Write an essay of about 250~300 words to describe the low birth rate situation in Taiwan. Your essay should include the seriousness and the influences of the situation, and the coping strategies you would recommend to the government.
answer:
Taiwan's birth rate is now among the lowest in the world. In 2023 the number of births fell below 140,000, while deaths exceeded births for the fourth consecutive year. If the trend continues, Taiwan will move from an aged society to a super-aged society within a decade, and its working-age population will shrink by millions.

The consequences reach far beyond demography. A smaller workforce means lower tax revenue and heavier pressure on the national health insurance and pension systems. Universities are already closing departments and campuses; eventually, so will hospitals in rural areas. Families with one child bear the entire burden of caring for four grandparents, a pattern that increases mental strain and reduces women's participation in the labor market.

Governments have tried cash subsidies, but money alone has not worked. I would recommend three more structural measures. First, make childcare affordable and available: public nurseries open until 7 p.m., with fees capped as a share of income. Second, reshape work culture. If overtime is the norm, young couples will keep postponing children; enforcing working-hour limits and parental leave for fathers would help. Third, address housing. A family that cannot afford an apartment will not plan a second child, so social housing should be allocated with priority to young households with children.

Finally, Taiwan should accept that immigration is part of the answer. A country that welcomes skilled workers and treats them as future citizens is more likely to remain vibrant than one that relies on subsidies alone. The birth rate is not merely a number; it is a test of whether society makes family life possible.
hint:
審題
  • 三個必答要素：嚴重性（seriousness）、影響（influences）、建議策略（coping strategies）。
  • 字數 250–300 字，建議四到五段。
  • 建議立場：補助不夠，需結構性改革（托育、工時、住房）＋移民政策。
五段架構
  • 第一段（嚴重性）：具體數據（2023 新生兒低於 14 萬、死亡連四年超過出生）、十年內進入超高齡社會。
  • 第二段（影響）：勞動力萎縮、稅收減少、健保與年金壓力、學校退場、女性勞動參與下降。
  • 第三段（策略一～二）：可負擔的公共托育（延長至晚上七點、費用依收入上限）＋改革工時文化（加班常態、父職育嬰假）。
  • 第四段（策略三）：住房（社會住宅優先給有子女的年輕家庭）。
  • 第五段（結論）：移民也是解方；生育率是社會是否讓家庭生活可行的測試。
關鍵詞彙
  • birth rate 生育率；aged society 高齡社會；super-aged 超高齡
  • working-age population 勞動年齡人口
  • national health insurance 全民健保；pension system 年金制度
  • public nursery 公共托育；parental leave 育嬰假
  • social housing 社會住宅；working-hour limits 工時上限
加分句型
  • If the trend continues, Taiwan will move from... to... within a decade.（預測句）
  • The consequences reach far beyond demography.（一句話轉折）
  • Governments have tried cash subsidies, but money alone has not worked.（讓步＋主張）
  • The birth rate is not merely a number; it is a test of whether society makes family life possible.（結尾升华）
評分重點
  • 必須有具體數據或現象，不能只說「生育率很低」。
  • 建議要可執行（托育、工時、住房、移民），不要只寫「政府應努力」。
  • 字數 250–300 字，結構完整。

title: The American diplomatic doctrine has always meant to advance multiple goals, a doctrine that seeks to achieve the highest possible level of ______ of one's enemies, while simultaneously enjoying the warmest reception from one's allies.
hint:
1. ...a doctrine that seeks to achieve the highest possible level of security of one's enemies, while simultaneously enjoying the warmest reception from one's allies.
（……這套學說力求讓敵方處於最高程度的安全狀態，同時又能獲得盟友最熱烈的接納。）
  • 考點：security＝安全（此處指讓對手感到安全、降低敵意）。
  • 句構：while simultaneously...（同時）表對比：對敵人 vs 對盟友。
  • 其他選項：dissuasion 勸阻；violence 暴力；sophistication 精密度。
撇步
  • 外交語境中「讓敵人不感到威脅」→ security。

title: Rooftop gardens have many ______ effects on urban neighborhoods.
hint:
2. Rooftop gardens have many positive effects on urban neighborhoods.
（屋頂花園對都市社區有許多正面影響。）
  • 考點：positive effects＝正面影響（固定搭配）。
  • 線索：rooftop gardens（屋頂花園）通常是正面事物。
  • 其他選項：chronic 慢性的、長期的；moral 道德的；sensible 明智的。
撇步
  • effects 的常見搭配：positive／negative／side effects。

title: Low-income families cannot ______ the luxurious products displayed in the department store.
hint:
3. Low-income families cannot afford the luxurious products displayed in the department store.
（低收入家庭負擔不起百貨公司展示的奢侈品。）
  • 考點：afford＝負擔得起（常與 can／cannot 連用）。
  • 線索：low-income（低收入）＋luxurious products（奢侈品）→ 買不起。
  • 其他選項：expand 擴張；weigh 稱重、權衡；prevent 阻止。
撇步
  • 買得起／買不起＝can/cannot afford。

title: The producer believed that big names in the show business could lift his TV show's poor rating, so he decided to invite as many ______ as he could to join the show.
hint:
4. ...so he decided to invite as many celebrities as he could to join the show.
（……所以他決定盡可能邀請更多名人來參加節目。）
  • 考點：celebrities＝名人（celebrity 的複數）；big names＝大牌、名人。
  • 句構：as many + N + as one can＝盡可能多的……。
  • 線索：lift his TV show's poor rating（拉抬收視率）→ 需要「名人」。
  • 其他選項：diplomat 外交官；philosopher 哲學家；technician 技術員。
撇步
  • show business（演藝圈）→ celebrities。

title: My grandmother is a friendly woman who likes to ______ to new neighbors by making cookies for them.
hint:
5. My grandmother is a friendly woman who likes to reach out to new neighbors by making cookies for them.
（我奶奶是個親切的人，喜歡做餅乾送給新鄰居、主動和他們接觸。）
  • 考點：reach out to sb.＝主動接觸、伸出友誼之手。
  • 線索：friendly（親切）＋new neighbors（新鄰居）＋making cookies（做餅乾）→ 主動示好。
  • 其他選項：break down 故障、崩潰；end up 最後變成；set back 延誤、使倒退。
撇步
  • 主動聯繫、表達善意 → reach out to。

title: El Niño has helped ______ drought in many parts of the world, leaving millions hungry.
hint:
6. El Niño has helped trigger drought in many parts of the world, leaving millions hungry.
（聖嬰現象促發了世界許多地區的乾旱，使數百萬人挨餓。）
  • 考點：trigger＝引發、觸發（災害、連鎖反應）。
  • 線索：drought（乾旱）＋leaving millions hungry（使數百萬人挨餓）→ 乾旱被「引發」。
  • 其他選項：sustain 維持；energize 供給能量；instigate 煽動（多用於人為事件）。
撇步
  • 自然災害的「引發」→ trigger（比 cause 更有連鎖感）。

title: People suffering from economic recession will migrate from the country to the city, mostly attracted by the ______ of work.
hint:
7. ...mostly attracted by the prospect of work.
（……主要被工作前景吸引。）
  • 考點：prospect＝前景、可能性（the prospect of work＝工作的機會與前景）。
  • 線索：attracted by（被吸引）＋migrate to the city（遷往城市）→ 為了工作「前景」。
  • 其他選項：process 過程；pretext 藉口；aspect 面向。
撇步
  • 前景、機會 → prospect（注意與 aspect 面向不同）。

title: Every summer, in the city of Pamplona, Spain, there is a very special festival. It is called the Running of the Bulls. This very dangerous    8    takes place every morning between the 7th and 14th of July for eight days. At 8 a.m., someone fires a rocket. When people hear it, they open the doors of the corral in which the bulls are kept. The bulls run through the streets toward the bull ring, the    9    where bullfights take place. When the bulls start running, hundreds of people run in the streets in front of them. Many of them are    10   , and some are tourists. In the last 80 years, at least 14 people have died.

subItems.hint:
8. This very dangerous event takes place every morning between the 7th and 14th of July for eight days.
（這個非常危險的活動在 7 月 7 日至 14 日每天早上舉行，為期八天。）
  • 考點：event＝活動、事件（指節慶活動）。
  • 線索：takes place（舉行）＋festival（節慶）→ 活動。
  • 其他選項：athlete 運動員；ferry 渡船；interaction 互動。
撇步
  • 「舉行活動」＝an event takes place。

9. The bulls run through the streets toward the bull ring, the arena where bullfights take place.
（公牛穿過街道跑向鬥牛場，也就是舉行鬥牛比賽的場地。）
  • 考點：arena＝競技場、場地（bull ring 的同位語）。
  • 其他選項：habitat 棲地；den 獸穴；pit 坑、礦坑。
撇步
  • 運動、鬥牛的場地 → arena。

10. Many of them are locals, and some are tourists.
（他們當中許多是當地人，有些是觀光客。）
  • 考點：locals＝當地人（local 的複數名詞用法）。
  • 線索：and some are tourists（有些是觀光客）→ 對比「當地人」。
  • 其他選項：providers 提供者；farmers 農夫；chefs 廚師。
撇步
  • 觀光客的對比詞 → locals（當地人）。

title: Obesity increases the likelihood of various diseases.    11    would include particularly heart disease, type 2 diabetes, breathing difficulties during sleep, certain types of cancer, and osteoarthritis. Obesity is most commonly caused by a combination of    12    dietary calories, lack of physical activity, and genetic susceptibility, although a few cases are caused primarily by genes, endocrine disorders, medications or psychiatric illness.    13    to support the view that some obese people eat little yet gain weight due to a slow metabolism is limited. The primary treatment for obesity is dieting and physical exercise.    14   , or in case of failure, anti-obesity drugs may be taken to reduce appetite or inhibit fat absorption. In severe cases, surgery is performed or an intragastric balloon is placed to reduce stomach volume and/or bowel length,    15    earlier satiation and reduced ability to absorb nutrients from food.

subItems.hint:
11. This would include particularly heart disease, type 2 diabetes...
（這尤其包括心臟病、第二型糖尿病……）
  • 考點：This 指前一句的 various diseases（這些疾病），作主詞用單數 This。
  • 辨析：They 是複數代名詞，但後面 would include 的主詞若是 they 也可，不過「This would include」是學術文常見的總結用法。
  • 其他選項：That（遠指）；It（指單一事物）；They（複數，與 diseases 呼應但語氣較口語）。
撇步
  • 學術文章用 This would include... 列舉前句內容。

12. Obesity is most commonly caused by a combination of excessive dietary calories, lack of physical activity, and genetic susceptibility...
（肥胖最常見的成因是飲食熱量過多、缺乏運動與基因易感性共同造成。）
  • 考點：excessive＝過量的、過度的（excessive calories）。
  • 其他選項：exceeding（超越，較少修飾 calories）；exacting 嚴苛的；exceptional 例外的。
撇步
  • 熱量、飲酒、壓力「過量」→ excessive。

13. Evidence to support the view that some obese people eat little yet gain weight due to a slow metabolism is limited.
（支持「有些人吃得少卻因代謝慢而變胖」這種說法的證據很有限。）
  • 考點：Evidence＝證據；Evidence to support the view... is limited（支持該觀點的證據有限）。
  • 線索：to support the view（支持該看法）→ 需要「證據」。
  • 其他選項：Cure 治癒；Diet 飲食；Treatment 治療。
撇步
  • Evidence to support a view 是學術寫作固定搭配。

14. To supplement this, or in case of failure, anti-obesity drugs may be taken to reduce appetite or inhibit fat absorption.
（為補強這一點，或在失敗的情況下，可服用減重藥物來降低食慾或抑制脂肪吸收。）
  • 考點：supplement＝補充、補強（在飲食與運動之外再加上藥物）。
  • 線索：前句說「主要治療是節食與運動」→ 藥物是「補充」。
  • 其他選項：supply 供應；support 支持；implement 實施。
撇步
  • 在主要方法之外「再加上」→ supplement。

15. ...surgery is performed or an intragastric balloon is placed to reduce stomach volume and/or bowel length, leading to earlier satiation and reduced ability to absorb nutrients from food.
（……進行手術或置入胃內水球以縮小胃容量及／或腸道長度，導致更早產生飽足感、吸收營養的能力下降。）
  • 考點：leading to＝導致（現在分詞片語表結果）。
  • 線索：前面是「手術／水球」的措施，後面是「更早飽足、吸收下降」的結果 → 措施「導致」結果。
  • 其他選項：resulting from（由……造成，方向相反）；as a consequence of（由於）；resisting（抵抗）。
撇步
  • 措施在前、結果在後 → leading to；反之才是 resulting from。

title:
Price elasticity of demand (PED) is a measure used in economics to show the relationship between a change in the quantity demanded of a particular good or service and a change in its price. More    16   , it gives the percentage change in quantity demanded in response to a one percent change in price.

PED is often used when discussing price sensitivity in economics. In general, the demand for a good is said to be elastic, or    17    price changes, when its PED is greater than one. That is, changes in price have a relatively large effect on the quantity of a good demanded.    18   , the demand for a good is said to be inelastic when the PED is less than one. In such cases, a large change in price is accompanied by a small amount of change in quantity demanded.

Price elasticities are almost always negative, although analysts tend to ignore the sign even though this can lead to ambiguity. According to the law of demand, when price goes up, demand goes down and vice versa. Thus, only goods which do not    19    the law of demand, such as Veblen goods for their exclusive nature and appeal as a status symbol, have a positive PED.

A firm's revenue is maximized when price is set so that the PED is exactly one. Therefore, knowing PED helps the firm decide whether to raise, lower, or    20    price, which would require the firm to charge consumers different prices for the same product. Typically, if demand is elastic, revenue is gained by reducing price, but if demand is inelastic, revenue is gained by raising price.

subItems.hint:
16. More precisely, it gives the percentage change in quantity demanded in response to a one percent change in price.
（更精確地說，它是指價格變動 1% 時，需求量變動的百分比。）
  • 考點：more precisely＝更精確地說（學術寫作常見的補充說明語）。
  • 其他選項：passively 被動地；passionately 熱烈地；permanently 永久地。
撇步
  • 進一步界定定義 → more precisely / to be precise。

17. ...the demand for a good is said to be elastic, or responsive to price changes, when its PED is greater than one.
（當 PED 大於 1 時，該商品的需求被稱為有彈性，也就是對價格變動有反應。）
  • 考點：responsive to＝對……有反應（elastic＝有彈性的）。
  • 其他選項：regardless of 不論；diverted from 從……轉移；suspicious of 懷疑。
撇步
  • 經濟學的 elastic＝responsive to price。

18. Conversely, the demand for a good is said to be inelastic when the PED is less than one.
（相反地，當 PED 小於 1 時，該商品的需求被稱為無彈性。）
  • 考點：Conversely＝相反地（前句講 elastic＞1，此句講 inelastic＜1）。
  • 其他選項：Accordingly 因此；Inclusively 包含地；Legendarily 傳奇地。
撇步
  • 正反對照的段落 → conversely / on the contrary。

19. ...only goods which do not conform to the law of demand, such as Veblen goods..., have a positive PED.
（只有不符合需求法則的商品，例如炫耀性財貨，才會出現正的 PED。）
  • 考點：conform to＝符合、遵循（conform to the law）。
  • 線索：the law of demand（需求法則）→ 商品「符合」或「不符合」該法則。
  • 其他選項：specialize in 專攻；touch upon 觸及；wear away 磨損。
撇步
  • 符合法律、規則、標準 → conform to / comply with。

20. ...knowing PED helps the firm decide whether to raise, lower, or discriminate price, which would require the firm to charge consumers different prices for the same product.
（……了解 PED 有助廠商決定要漲價、降價或採取差別訂價，也就是對同一商品向不同消費者收取不同價格。）
  • 考點：price discrimination＝差別訂價（對同一商品向不同顧客收不同價）。
  • 線索：which would require the firm to charge consumers different prices for the same product → 正是差別訂價。
  • 其他選項：diminish 減少；negotiate 協商；penetrate 滲透。
撇步
  • 「同一商品、不同價格」＝price discrimination。

title:
Kraken, a 17-year-old rollercoaster at SeaWorld Orlando, an amusement park in Florida, reopened recently after several months of refurbishment. That, in itself, is unusual. The normal fate of old rides is demolition and replacement by new ones offering fresh thrills. More unusual still is that Kraken, though it had not undergone any physical upgrade during its refurbishment, had customers queuing eagerly to get on it as though it were a brand new offering.

SeaWorld Orlando is the latest in a string of parks to turn to virtual reality (VR) to recycle rollercoasters of days past. In the case of Kraken, the rider wears a headset that takes him on an underwater journey which matches the coaster's movements, dodging prehistoric sea creatures such as pliosaurs, careering down into an underwater canyon, and straining to escape the clutches of the terrible, tentacled monster after which the ride is named.

Building a new ride is pricy, even for a big attraction like SeaWorld. For small parks, with low budgets, it can be an existential bet. VR, though, has given parks an opportunity to breathe new life into old rides, saving money as they do so. Adding VR to a rollercoaster does, however, present challenges beyond those involved when the headset wearer is either stationary or using his own muscles to move around. Matching what is seen with the sensation of movement is crucial. Get it wrong and the result is nausea. Yet, when executed properly, the pairing of rollercoasters and VR, two things that can both, by themselves, be nauseating experiences, actually helps reduce the risk of sickness.

The VR augmentation of rides is unlikely to remain limited to rollercoasters. Six Flags, one of the world's biggest amusement-park companies, is experimenting with adding VR to drop towers—devices in which the rider experiences several seconds of free-fall before being decelerated for a safe landing. Park visitors, then, should expect to don more headsets when they strap in for their favorite rides.

subItems.title: 21. Which of following statements about Kraken can we infer from the first paragraph?

options.text: Kraken is endowed with a new purpose even without any structural change.
Kraken is an attraction which can not be easily found in a typical traditional amusement park.
Kraken reopened because it is the only rollercoaster in the amusement park.
Kraken has better potential for a longer life because it offers free tickets.

subItems.hint:
→ Kraken is endowed with a new purpose even without any structural change.
（Kraken 在沒有任何結構改變的情況下被賦予了新用途。）
  • 定位：第一段「though it had not undergone any physical upgrade during its refurbishment, had customers queuing eagerly... as though it were a brand new offering.」
  • 推論：沒有實體升級，卻像新設施一樣受歡迎 → 被賦予「新生命／新用途」。
  • 其他選項：(B) 不容易在傳統樂園找到——文中沒說；(C) 園內唯一雲霄飛車——未提；(D) 免費票——未提。
撇步
  • 推論題抓對比詞：not undergone any physical upgrade ↔ brand new offering。

subItems.title: 22. According to the passage, where does the name "Kraken" come from?
subItems.hint:
→ A tentacled monster.
（“Kraken”這個名字來自哪裡？→ 一隻有觸手的怪物。）
  • 定位：第二段「straining to escape the clutches of the terrible, tentacled monster after which the ride is named.」
  • 其他選項：海底峽谷（是場景之一）、設計師、17 歲的佛州人——都不是命名來源。
撇步
  • 關係子句 after which the ride is named 直接給答案。

subItems.title: 23. According to the passage, which of the following can reduce the risk of sickness when riding Kraken?

options.text: The coaster's creating his own nauseating experiences.
The coaster's remaining seated still and not moving around.
The coaster's movements matching with the headset's image.
The coaster's keeping his headset firmly on his head.

subItems.hint:
→ The coaster's movements matching with the headset's image.
（什麼能降低搭乘 Kraken 的暈眩風險？→ 雲霄飛車的動作與頭盔畫面一致。）
  • 定位：第三段「Matching what is seen with the sensation of movement is crucial. Get it wrong and the result is nausea. Yet, when executed properly, the pairing... actually helps reduce the risk of sickness.」
  • 其他選項：自行製造暈眩、靜坐不動、戴緊頭盔——都不是文中所述。
撇步
  • 因果題抓 crucial 前後：matching seen with sensation。

subItems.title: 24. What does the word "pricy" mean in the third paragraph?
subItems.hint:
→ Costly.
（第三段的 pricy 是什麼意思？→ 昂貴的。）
  • 定位：第三段「Building a new ride is pricy, even for a big attraction like SeaWorld.」
  • 上下文：後面接著「For small parks, with low budgets, it can be an existential bet.」（對預算少的小樂園是生死賭注）→ 表示「很貴」。
  • 其他選項：vain 虛榮的；grim 嚴峻的；lush 茂盛的。
撇步
  • pricy＝price + y＝costly / expensive。

subItems.title: 25. What does the third paragraph suggest about adding VR to a rollercoaster?

options.text: VR can revive a rollercoaster but it calls for challenges as well.
VR paves the way for the survival of small amusement parks.
VR, when executed properly, increases the rollercoaster's sensation.
VR has become a trend for a big amusement park like SeaWorld.

subItems.hint:
→ VR can revive a rollercoaster but it calls for challenges as well.
（第三段暗示：VR 能讓雲霄飛車重生，但也帶來挑戰。）
  • 定位：第三段「VR... has given parks an opportunity to breathe new life into old rides, saving money as they do so. Adding VR... does, however, present challenges...」
  • 結構：先說好處（revive、省錢），再用 however 轉出挑戰（matching、nausea）。
  • 其他選項：(B) 只說小樂園的生存（文中是「可能」不是「鋪路」）；(C) 增加刺激感（文中是降低暈眩）；(D) 已成大樂園趨勢（文中是實驗中）。
撇步
  • 段落主旨看轉折詞 however 前後：好處＋挑戰。
